title: Prepare Site for TVC-governed HIL intake projection
coordination_rule: TVC retains exclusive deployment, protected-value consumption, execution-grant issuance, revocation, and runtime authority. Site assistance is non-authorizing and limited to sanitized projection, validation, and public-state boundaries.
required_actions: Verify hil-direct-ingress-worker.yml exists and remains the exact bound workflow
Verify incoming/hil source-object handling is fail-closed
Prepare sanitized intake receipt import without accepting protected values
Validate durable ingress receipts separately from participant-device fallback records
Accept TVC execution evidence only when commit-pinned, hash-bound, non-secret, and authority-scoped
Preserve unrelated Site routes and deployments
coordination_checkpoints: execution grant is issued and independently validated
grant consumption and revocation receipts are retained
Site receives sanitized intake and custody projection
public readiness remains false until authentic TVC evidence is imported
acceptance_criteria: Site holds no TV or TVC protected value
worker activation remains bound to authenticated internal intake evidence
receipt projection contains hashes, identities, states, timestamps, and scoped outcomes only
participant-device fallback cannot be represented as durable submission
no public readiness claim occurs before authentic TVC execution evidence
no Site action grants runtime, execution, publication, release, or custody authority
